notes.calculated: Calculated from published MHCLG figures: the council's Band D excluding local precepts (Table 10, line 9), plus the parish Band D (parish return), plus the Band D precepts of the county council or GLA, police, fire and combined authority (Table 10, line 16). Exact to the billed penny where the council charges no special expenses, apart from possible 1p rounding in the parish Band D as reported (MHCLG note h).
notes.groupMember: This parish is grouped with others for precepting purposes (MHCLG note f) and has no tax base of its own. It takes the Band D of the one row in the council that carries the group's precept and tax base.
notes.groupUnresolved: This parish is grouped with others for precepting purposes (MHCLG note f) and has no tax base of its own. The return does not identify one row that carries its group, so it is listed under its group and not put in order.
notes.specialExpenses: This council charges special expenses in parts of its area. The national tables spread them across the whole council, so they cannot give the bill in each parish or unparished area. Per area totals are published by the council only.
notes.schedule: The council's own published schedule of council tax by area, quoted as printed.
notes.unparished: The part of the council area with no parish council: the council's Band D excluding local precepts (Table 10, line 9) plus the major precepts. Its tax base is calculated as the council's tax base (Table 10, line 7) less the sum of the parish tax bases.
notes.unparishedTrustee: The part of the council area with no parish council, which charter trustees cover in full (their tax base equals the unparished tax base). The trustees' Band D is added.
notes.trusteeInUnparished: Charter trustees cover the whole unparished area of this council. Their Band D is included in the unparished area's figure, so it is not shown as a separate place.
notes.trusteeInSchedule: The council's own schedule marks each parish and unparished area that the charter trustees cover, and its figures include their Band D, so they are not shown as a separate place.
notes.partialTrustee: Charter trustees cover only part of the unparished area of this council, so it has more than one Band D and the national tables cannot say which applies where.
notes.negative: A negative precept as published: the council returns rental income from parish land to residents as a reduction on their council tax (MHCLG note i).
notes.rounding: Parish Band D amounts are as reported by councils and billed, so they may differ by 1p from the precept divided by the tax base (MHCLG note h). They are used as published.
notes.constituencySplit: The wards this area touches lie in more than one constituency (ONS ward to constituency lookup). It is listed under each and never apportioned.
notes.constituencyUnmatched: Not matched to an ONS parish code by name, so no constituency is given.
notes.constituencyNone: Charter trustee and Temple areas have no ONS parish code, so no constituency is given.
notes.constituencyUnparished: Constituencies of the council's wards that contain no parish (ONS lookups). Wards that are partly parished are not counted, so the list may be incomplete.
notes.constituencyNoWard: Every ward in this council contains a parish, so the unparished area cannot be placed in a constituency from the ONS lookups.
notes.noComparison: Not comparable: a full bill change needs 2025/26 Table 10 components, which this dataset does not hold. The parish part change is from the same row of the parish return.
